$comment: Draft from the Google and Meta packs' daily reads (2026-10-31). ads.results/1 needs a creative_code, so a Search or Shopping campaign cannot be written there.
title: ads.spend/1
description: What an account spent and got, per entity and day, on the platform's own numbers: one grain for every platform, so measurement can read Google and Meta alike. An operator writes it from its cache.
x-rules: Counts are real even when amount_kind is index; an index of one document is never compared with another document's.
A value the platform or the client withheld is absent, never 0.
A day not settled is marked so; the reader does not treat it as final.

producer.description: The pack that wrote the document (its CLI word).

produced_at.description: When the document was written: ISO 8601 with its zone.

rows.description: One row per entity per day.

platform.description: The platform, in the pack's own word (google, meta, ...).

account.description: The account the numbers belong to, as the pack names it (never a real account id in an example).

entity_id.description: The entity's id on the platform.

campaign_type.description: The campaign type, when the platform has one (search, shopping, pmax, demand_gen, ...).

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the account's own time zone.

amount_kind.description: money: spend and conv_value are amounts in `currency`. index: they are indexes of the document's own median, comparable inside this document only.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code; present when amount_kind is money.

spend.description: The cost, in the unit amount_kind names.

conversions.description: Conversions on the platform's own attribution; always a real count.

conv_value.description: Conversion value, in the unit amount_kind names.

settled.description: True when the platform will no longer restate the day.
